data.action: 扶着栏杆仰望巨型天体
data.camera: cowboy shot, leaning on ship railing
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 研究舰甲板】先遣研究舰顶层甲板上，夜风吹拂着佩丽卡干练利落的制服风衣。她双手扶着合金栏杆，仰望着天幕中缓缓旋转的巨大异星天体与璀璨星环，眼底泛起少有的柔和——「在这浩瀚孤独的星海深处……能与您并肩站在同一个指挥甲板上，是我执行过的最荣幸的使命。」
data.promptProse: Perlica grips the research ship's alloy railing with both hands and looks upward at the immense alien planet and luminous rings. Her white-and-charcoal supervisor trench coat moves in the night wind. The cowboy view includes the deck behind her and the railing extending toward the ship's bow. Starlight and planet glow trace her pale coat shoulders and rail top, leaving its underside and the deck in cool shade.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 研究舰甲板
